li.label: mechanoid ground
li.description: The metal underfoot hums faintly with the lattice's presence. It's oddly soothing.

li.label: mechanoid ground (spreading)
li.description: The lattice has taken real root here. Being surrounded by it feels like being watched over.

li.label: mechanoid ground (pervasive)
li.description: The lattice dominates everything nearby. There's a strange comfort in being this deep inside it.

li.label: mechanoid ground (total)
li.description: Nothing natural remains close by. The lattice's presence is total, and total is somehow restful.

li.label: one with the machine
li.description: The land itself belongs to the lattice now. Being at its heart feels less like living beside something vast, and more like being a part of it.
